notes: Elspeth's Smite, printed: 'deals 3 damage to target attacking or blocking creature. If that creature would die this turn, exile it instead.' Seat 0 attacks with a 2/2; seat 1 blocks it with a 3/3. After blockers are declared seat 0 (with a Plains) casts Smite at the blocker: 3 damage kills it, so it is exiled instead. The attacker stays blocked and deals no combat damage, so seat 1 stays at 20 and the attacker is unharmed.
